summary: Two teenage cousins (16, 18) on an overnight winter camping trip reported overdue Sunday evening; vehicle found at Mitchell Lake trailhead (Brainard Lake Recreation Area, near Ward); RMRG team located them Monday ~6:30 am after an 18-hour effort - cold, wet, frozen shoes, suffering frostbite after winds shredded their tent; a second team hiked in dry clothes and walked them out to their parents ~noon.
location: Mitchell Lake trailhead, Brainard Lake Recreation Area, near Ward
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Boulder County Sheriff's Office
notes: INSERTED run 985 (SnowBrains chunk): article published 2018-10-18; teens set out Saturday afternoon, found Monday 2018-10-15 (Monday-verified); BCSO cited via KDVR; overdue/search context.
